verdict.rationale: Cooley documents both M&A/exit strength ("#1 law firm representing VC-backed companies going public for the last 20 years") and dedicated IPO tooling (AI-assisted S-1 drafting), alongside deep venture-financing credentials (2,100+ VC financings annually, #1 ranked VC financing firm), showing a documented path from formation through exit. Missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration of M&A-specific (non-IPO) exit experience or client-side hands-on account of an actual exit engagement.
